includeParticipants.description: Include the host, speakers and listeners on the Space row and emit one separate "space participant" row per participant with their profile details.
includeParticipants.title: Include participants

includeReplayAudio.description: Include the HLS replay audio link and, when a file can be produced, a downloadable replay file stored for you.
includeReplayAudio.title: Include replay audio link

includeTranscript.description: Produce a spoken-word transcript of the Space replay. Uses captions when available and otherwise AI speech recognition (slower).
includeTranscript.title: Include transcript

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

spaceUrls.description: Paste the links of the Spaces you want to collect, for example https://x.com/i/spaces/1YpKkZgnrDXxj. Space IDs work too, and you can also paste the post that announces a Space (the actor finds the Space from its card automatically). Accepts both x.com and twitter.com links.
spaceUrls.title: Space links, Space IDs or Space posts

transcriptSegmentsAsRows.description: In addition to the transcript summary row, push one "space transcript segment" row per timed segment (index, start, end, text). Useful for joining or exporting segment-level data.
transcriptSegmentsAsRows.title: Emit transcript segments as separate rows

transcriptionMethod.description: How the transcript should be produced.
transcriptionMethod.title: Transcription method

whisperModel.description: Which speech recognition model to use when AI transcription runs. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
whisperModel.title: AI transcription quality
